title: This app is weird.
body: Software engineer here. Can’t comprehend why does it requires background app refresh to display the timer across devices. Other apps with very similar design can get ahead without it. Sometimes I see a black screen and the countdown on Apple Watch while multitasking in the dock. If the UI drops, just render the countdown with task name or allow me to choose myself how do I want to see time left for timed task. Lack of Up Next view on Apple Watch is a massive turn off for me. I use four separate pages to group tasks by nature: physical, mind etc. The dots widget on AW isn’t dynamic so once a day task gets complete I cannot see a new one I can accomplish from a different page. For repetitive timed tasks: lack of notification repeat if frustrating. Let’s say I make squats 8 times per day each hour. The only way for me to get reminded is by manually entering times for each of those. Rather than following a more rational flow: get a notification -> squat -> countdown starts once the user taps the round is completed. I would say with the current functionality this app is worth around 50% of the asking price.

title: Simple, polished app.
body:
Streaks knows its purpose and does the job well. The interface is clean, there are no distractions, even when it asks for a review, it does so in an elegant way. I bought it in a bundle with Streaks Workout, which I absolutely adore. This is 'just' very good, so if you seem to like it, at least take a look at the other app.

Some notes on what's offered. You can choose up to six actions to track, every one can be attached to certain days. So I can track chess practice on fridays and wednesdays, and bodyweight workouts every day except Sunday. You only have to type the name of the activity, and the app tries to guess the icon for you. As soon as I have written Chess practice, a chess piece icon was attached. This is a good example of the attention to detail shown here.

All in all, a very good app. I will follow further offerings from this developer.

title: A real pleasure to use
body: This app is so AWESOME. Beautifully designed, incredibly easy to use and most important of all: actually works. There's something special about wanting to keep a streak that makes you want to do the desired task again and soon enough it becomes a habit. I would really love to have the option to add more than 6 tasks though. I've already ran out of available tasks. Let's say you want to measure your weight daily, drink at least 1,5l of water daily, workout 3 times a week, run twice a week, read a book on the weekends, study another language on week days. That's already 6 tasks and I'd like to add more. I understand that one of the strengths of Streaks is to keep it simple, but it simply isn't enough. I'd love to use Streaks not only as a "habit creating" app but also as a motivation to keep doing several other things and let's be honest: 6 tasks isn't even equal to the number of days in a week - maybe limit it to 6 tasks a day if you want to keep it simple? Bring it on, Streaks! Anyway, I highly recommend Streaks. :)
